title: Module Review Quiz: Variables & Data Types (CPP_111 to CPP_118)

slides.title: Variables & Data Types Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers data types, variable declarations, initialization, type casting, scopes, and string basics in C++ (CPP_111 to CPP_118).

slides.title: Integer Declaration (CPP_111)
slides.prompt: Fill in the correct data type to store whole numbers without decimals.

slides.title: Floating Point Types (CPP_112)
slides.prompt: Which data type is recommended when higher precision floating-point numbers are needed?

slides.title: Character Literal (CPP_113)
slides.prompt: Fill in the missing character literal enclosed in single quotes.

slides.title: Boolean Values (CPP_114)
slides.prompt: What are the two valid truth values that a 'bool' variable can hold in C++?

slides.title: String Class (CPP_115)
slides.prompt: Fill in the missing header file needed to use the std::string data type.

slides.title: Type Casting (CPP_116)
slides.prompt: What is the result of static_cast<int>(9.8)?

slides.title: Implicit Conversion (CPP_116)
slides.prompt: Fill in the variable type that gets automatically converted during double to int assignment.

slides.title: Variable Scope (CPP_117)
slides.prompt: Where can a local variable declared inside a function be accessed?

slides.title: Auto Keyword (CPP_118)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used for automatic type inference in C++.

slides.title: Size of Data Types (CPP_111)
slides.prompt: Which operator is used to check the memory size of a data type in bytes?

slides.title: Initialization Styles (CPP_111)
slides.prompt: Fill in the syntax for uniform/list initialization in C++11.

slides.title: Const Variable Rules (CPP_118)
slides.prompt: What happens if a variable declared with 'const' is not initialized during declaration?

slides.title: String Concatenation (CPP_115)
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator used to combine two std::string variables together.

slides.title: Unsigned Integers (CPP_111)
slides.prompt: What range of values can an 'unsigned int' store?
